messages:
elaine: FYI — after flipping FlashAttention v3 kernels on the canary pool we see a consistent latency bump for mid-length requests (seq 128-256). Numbers: +12% p50, +18% p95 for some models. Not seeing it at short (<64) or long (1024) seqs. Anyone seen this pattern?

sam: same. Repro on local perf harness? Did you pin to align workspace sizes? Could be workspace allocation causing extra memcpy. :thinking_face:

elaine: repro on perf harness and canary traffic. Attached microbench:
```
model: redwood-xxl
batch=1 seq=128 tokens/sec=620 -> baseline 700
seq=32 tokens/sec=1400 -> baseline 1420
```
Also noticed GPU memory clip spikes.

miguel: possibly v3's padding handling changes workspace rounding. v3 packs tiles differently; that can increase intermediate buffers for mid seq. We have heuristics in kernel selector that pick v3 for >64, but maybe threshold wrong.

anya: logging from runtime: `kernel_choice=flashattn_v3` `workspace_bytes=48MB` on seq=128. Baseline used v2 with workspace 20MB. That explains mem pressure. :eyes:

elaine: good catch. Is selector using per-model shape hist or global thresholds?

miguel: currently global heuristic + per-model override. RFC said fallback to v2 for mem>limit, but maybe we disabled fallback for perf reasons.

sam: can we quickly try forcing v2 on the canary for seq 128 to confirm regression source?

infra-bot: deploy started by @sam: runtime-config canary->force_kernel=flashattn_v2 for tag=canary-2026-03-18

elaine: after forcing v2 on canary p50 returned to baseline. So v3 kernels are the culprit.

anya: logs show extra memcpy and two-stage kernel launch on v3 when seq not multiple of tile size. Patch idea: add prepad to 256 when seq in (96..192) and small batches to avoid splitting? But prepad increases token work.

miguel: prepad trades off compute vs memcpy. Could be better than extra kernel overhead. Need modelling. Also check quantization/path differences: v3 path uses fused-softmax that uses 32-bit accumulation — slightly different scheduling.

sam: data collection task: gather shape histogram for last 7 days per model, focus on seq distribution, batch sizes, and kernel choice. Also collect GPU memcpy time breakdown.

elaine: I'll add a telemetry flag: `attn_v3_memcopy_time_ms` and `attn_kernelfallback_reason`.

anya: opened perf PR to add histograms -> link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842

miguel: long term: selector should be cost-model-based: estimate token-ms = kernel_time + memcpy + prepad_cost. RFC follow-up item.

elaine: agreed. Also add canary auto-rollout guard: if p95 increases >5% for 24h revert automatically.

sam: can we also test small batch sizes? v3 seems worse at batch=1 mid-seq.

elaine: tests queued on perf harness. Will update thread with numbers.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed (force_kernel removed) after metric alert at 1865008210
